captions.absolute_gate_brier_profiles: Raw absolute estimates with numerically guarded pointwise 95% Monte Carlo intervals in the finite fixed-design audit. Lines connect the evaluated N=20, 40, and 80 snapshots.
captions.attenuation_interactions: Calibration-penalty interactions between the evaluated N=20 and N=80 snapshots, with numerically guarded familywise simultaneous 95% max-t bands. A guarded-negative interaction supports finite-range attenuation only when its matched N=20 penalty is guarded-positive.
captions.calibration_penalties: Erroneous-minus-correct assumed toxicity-noise contrasts with numerically guarded familywise simultaneous 95% max-t bands in the finite fixed-design audit. Lines connect the evaluated N=20, 40, and 80 snapshots.
captions.cei_reference: Shared-gate cEI reference contrasts with numerically guarded familywise simultaneous 95% max-t bands in the finite fixed-design audit. This reference is not a four-policy ranking.
captions.principal_profile: cKG-minus-tMSE-only and cKG-minus-Entropy contrasts with numerically guarded familywise simultaneous 95% max-t bands in the finite fixed-design audit. Lines connect the evaluated N=20, 40, and 80 snapshots.

estimands.family_A: cKG minus comparator for true-boundary-exceeding terminal recommendation and assignment outcomes at every 3-by-3 budget/calibration cell
estimands.family_B: erroneous c_sigma minus correct c_sigma=1 for target exclusion and panel Brier score
estimands.family_C: Family-B penalty at N=80 minus the corresponding penalty at N=20; guarded-negative values can support finite-range attenuation only under the frozen N=20 guarded-positive condition

band_classification.negative: numerically guarded simultaneous upper endpoint is strictly below zero
band_classification.positive: numerically guarded simultaneous lower endpoint is strictly above zero
band_classification.unresolved: numerically guarded simultaneous band includes zero, including an endpoint exactly equal to zero

interpretation.budget_robust_within_factor: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite at N=20, 40, and 80 for that c_sigma
interpretation.calibration_robust_at_N40: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite at all three c_sigma values at N=40
interpretation.finite_range_attenuation: Family-B N=20 penalty is guarded-positive and the matched Family-C interaction is guarded-negative over the evaluated N=20 to N=80 range
interpretation.full_grid_robust: terminal and assignment directions are each guarded-resolved consistently and are opposite in all nine evaluated budget-by-c_sigma cells
prohibited_inferences: sameness from an interval that includes zero
behavior outside the three evaluated finite snapshots
a clinical enrollment requirement from per-stratum simulated enrollment
robustness to model errors outside the frozen toxicity-noise-SD perturbation
a four-policy ranking from the cEI shared-gate reference

secondary_interval_classification.negative: numerically guarded pointwise upper endpoint is strictly below zero
secondary_interval_classification.positive: numerically guarded pointwise lower endpoint is strictly above zero
secondary_interval_classification.unavailable: the frozen conditional diagnostic has no eligible denominator
secondary_interval_classification.unresolved: numerically guarded pointwise interval includes zero, including an endpoint exactly equal to zero

interpretation.shared_gate_history_compatibility: Within one frozen factor-budget-metric cell, guarded-positive calibration penalties for all four policies together with unresolved guarded policy-vs-cEI differentials are compatible with shared-gate fragility; any guarded-resolved differential shows that policy-induced histories modify sensitivity

labels.c_sigma_axis: Assumed / true toxicity observation-noise SD, c_sigma
labels.metric_exclusion: True panel OBD excluded from terminal gate (%)

secondary_projection.inference_scope: cell-specific guarded pointwise statements only; no majority vote or family theorem
